title: Integrated release slate and fallback telemetry runbook for API/Console/Runtime
creator: Asha Raman
description: Scope: Coordinate a single, integrated release slate that aligns the API, Console, and Runtime teams. Deliverables include a component-aware gate matrix, a release notes bundling plan, a GTM checklist for documentation/marketing/support, and a lightweight fallback telemetry and signal runbook to drive automated rollbacks/mitigations. We aim to minimize cross-team churn during the cut window while preserving the ability to safely rollback individual components with minimal customer disruption.
milestones: 2026-03-05: Finalize component scope freeze (owners confirm features and known blockers)
2026-03-12: Cut window opens for doc/marketing assets and pre-recorded demos
2026-03-18: Runtime and API candidate builds tagged; smoke tests and canary config validated
2026-03-22: Console UI build tagged; release notes draft finalized and reviewed
2026-03-25: Cross-team signoff meeting; readiness vote; deploy freeze enforced
2026-03-28: Launch window and staged rollout begins
component_gates: Runtime gate: 99th p95 latency within SLO for 48h on canary + KV cache stability verified
API gate: End-to-end request success rate > 99.8% on staging + auth/edge tests green
Console gate: Critical flows (create model endpoint, rollout UI) validated with UX obs and regression test coverage >= 90%
Cross-component gate: Integration tests for model variant fallback and policy routing pass across staging clusters
cut_criteria: No open P0 regressions across runtime/api/console components
All release-blocking dependencies merged and smoke-tested in canary environment
Docs and release notes draft in final review with assigned author and reviewer
Telemetry dashboards created and baseline signals captured for first 72h post-rollout
Rollback playbook verified in staging with a dry-run executed by on-call engineers
release_notes_plan: Single canonical release notes artifact that aggregates component sections (API, Console, Runtime) with component owners listed
Template: Summary, What changed (user-facing), Migration notes/Breaking changes, Known issues, Rollout plan, Contact/Support links
Owners: Drafting - Product writers (Carla Simmons), Technical review - ENG leads (runtime: Priya Shah, API: Mark Liu, Console: Elena Park)
Channels: Release notes posted to Docs site, email digest to customers in early access, internal TL;DR to Sales/Support/Success
Changelog tagging: Use release tags runtime-2.0 / console-2026.03 / api-2026.03 and include links to relevant PRs and issues
gtm_tasks: Create customer-facing one-pager highlighting performance improvements and cost controls
Hallway demo for Sales and Solutions (recorded + live Q&A slot scheduled 2026-03-24)
Support playbook: triage matrix + top 6 troubleshooting runbooks drafted and linked
Marketing assets: banner, blog draft, and sample queries for demo environment
Partner comms: notify Dedicated/Private channel partners of planned schema and rollout windows
fallback_telemetry_runbook: Primary signals: request_success_rate, p95_latency, kv_cache_hit_ratio, error_budget_consumed, deployment_cpu/gpu_throttle
Signal thresholds: p95_latency > 1.5x baseline OR error rate > 0.5% sustained for 10m triggers alert
Automated mitigation: route new requests to last-known-good model variant and switch to degraded throughput policy for non-critical tenants
Manual escalation: if automated mitigation does not recover metrics within 15m, initiate component rollback (see rollback_criteria)
Post-incident: capture timeline, root cause hypothesis, and checklist for postmortem within 72h
rollback_criteria: Sustained SLO breach (>30m) after automated mitigations applied
P0 customer-impact bug confirmed affecting multiple customers or core flows
Critical security issue or data integrity risk identified
Rollback decision requires cross-team majority signoff (PM, ENG leads, SRE lead) and documented rollback plan
